# Comparison tables for module G (generated by experiments/analyzeG.py)

Time = median of 5 runs after one warm-up, with the interquartile range (IQR). ops = operations as defined in the README (comparisons + moves + windows examined + table cells + split candidates + enumerated bracketings or cuts; recursive calls are in the note of results.csv). mem = peak memory beyond the input.
